references.text: Describes the same skin conditions (baheret/light spots) that the priest must examine for leprosy
Parallel text about white or reddish spots as signs of a skin disease after boils
Continuation of the law concerning burns and how the priest must examine and judge the condition
Law regarding burn injury (מִכְוָה) - the same Hebrew word is used for burning
Isaiah mentions a brand mark as punishment, using related terminology for burn injuries
